transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

transactionStatus.description: Current status of the refund transaction

brandId.description: Brand identifier associated with the transaction

paymentMethodId.description: Payment method identifier associated with the refund, if applicable

type.description: Type identifier for Buy Now, Pay Later refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed through a BNPL provider like Klarna or Afterpay, typically reducing or canceling the customer's outstanding balance.

institutionName.description: Display name of the financial institution used for the buy now, pay later refund provider

BuyNowPayLaterRefundType.description: Type identifier for Buy Now, Pay Later refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed through a BNPL provider like Klarna or Afterpay, typically reducing or canceling the customer's outstanding balance.

type.description: Type identifier for card refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed back to the original payment card or to a different card specified by the customer.

last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card number

reference.description: [DEPRECATED] A reference identifier for this refund, if applicable. Use the top-level reference field instead. Nullable.

referenceStatus.description: [DEPRECATED] The status of the reference for this refund, if applicable. Use the top-level referenceStatus field instead. Nullable.

referenceType.description: [DEPRECATED] The type of reference for this refund, if applicable. Use the top-level referenceType field instead. Nullable.

CardRefundType.description: Type identifier for card refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed back to the original payment card or to a different card specified by the customer.

type.description: Type identifier for cash reward refund funding details. Used when refunds are credited back to the customer's Super Payments cash reward balance instead of their original payment method.

institutionName.description: Display name of the financial institution used for the cash reward refund provider

CashRewardRefundType.description: Type identifier for cash reward refund funding details. Used when refunds are credited back to the customer's Super Payments cash reward balance instead of their original payment method.

type.description: Type identifier for open banking refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed directly to a customer's bank account using Open Banking payment rails.

institutionName.description: Display name of the financial institution used for the open banking refund provider

OpenBankingRefundType.description: Type identifier for open banking refund funding details. Used when refunds are processed directly to a customer's bank account using Open Banking payment rails.

RefundOutputStatus.description: Current status of the refund transaction

amountInMinorUnits.description: The amount of this refund payment in minor units (e.g., cents).

fundingInstitution.description: The name of the funding institution for this refund payment, if applicable (e.g., bank name). Deprecated: use the institutionName field in the fundingDetails object instead.

fundingCard.description: Details of the card used for this refund payment, if applicable. Deprecated: use the card details in the fundingDetails object instead.

reference.description: A reference identifier for this refund payment, if applicable. Nullable.

referenceStatus.description: The status of the reference for this refund payment, if applicable. Nullable.

referenceType.description: The type of reference for this refund payment, if applicable (e.g., acquirer_reference_number). Nullable.

fundingDetails.description: Detailed information about the funding method used for this specific refund payment.

lastFourDigits.description: The last four digits of the card used for the refund payment.

brand.description: The brand of the card used for the refund payment (e.g., Visa, Mastercard).
